name: Foundation of Overcoming
description: Tapu Koko's followers are almost preternaturally adverse to fear, seeing anything that sets their heart ablaze as a new chance to grow.
effect: Devotees of the Spirit Guardian of Overcoming may call upon "Foundation of Overcoming" once per quest as a bonus action to summon Electric Terrain. At Luminary, they may expend 1 Will when their Terrain would end for any reason. If they do so, they retain a personalized Electric Terrain that only affects them and can exist with another Terrain. This personalized Terrain lasts for 4 Turns. Furthermore, at Luminary, only Allies benefit from the Damage Dice increase of your Electric Terrain. At Paragon, as long as any Terrain is active they gain a bonus to their Init equal to their Rank, and their Init cannot be reduced.
